gaps.lead: The doctor advised a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: I'm sure the tickets are expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: must be = I'm sure it is (deduction).

gaps.lead: He was in the habit of jogging every morning.
gaps.explanation: be used to + -ing = be in the habit of: was used to jogging.

gaps.lead: They say the new bridge will cut journey times in half.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ in half by the new bridge.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: journey times are said to be cut.

gaps.lead: He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.

gaps.answer: was used to / had got used to
gaps.lead: I got used to night shifts after a month.
gaps.sentence: After a month, I ___ night shifts.
gaps.explanation: After a period: be used to (state) or had got used to (achievement).
